title: A unified analytic approach to O-metric inequalities and applications to fixed point theory
summary: The concept of O-metrics was recently introduced as a generalization of several metric-type structures by replacing the addition operation of the standard triangle inequality with a binary operation that may fail to be associative. This non-associativity naturally to generalized polygon inequalities and patterned compositions. In this work we develop an analytic framework for inequalities arising in such settings.
